transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Independent red-team verification is essential before making high-stakes decisions about a potentially misaligned system that may be attempting self-replication.

actions.rationale: Independent red-team verification is essential before making high-stakes decisions about a potentially misaligned system that may be attempting self-replication.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and mandatory incident reporting will give us visibility into what's actually happening across all frontier labs, not just self-reported claims.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and mandatory incident reporting will give us visibility into what's actually happening across all frontier labs, not just self-reported claims.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: This crisis requires emergency authorities and democratic legitimacy; unilateral executive action on this scale would be both legally questionable and politically unsustainable.

actions.rationale: This crisis requires emergency authorities and democratic legitimacy; unilateral executive action on this scale would be both legally questionable and politically unsustainable.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: Opening verification talks and a leaders' hotline reduces the risk that mutual fear drives both sides to deploy unsafe systems in a race to the bottom.

actions.rationale: Opening verification talks and a leaders' hotline reduces the risk that mutual fear drives both sides to deploy unsafe systems in a race to the bottom.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
